Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding election dates for educational service district board members.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to election dates for educational service districtboard members; and amending RCW 28A.310.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.310.080 and 2006 c 263 s 602 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Not later than the twentyfifth day of August of every ((evennumbered)) oddnumbered year, the superintendent of public instructionshall call an election to be held in each educational service districtwithin which resides a member of the board of the educational servicedistrict whose term of office expires on the second Monday of Januarynext following, and shall give written notice thereof to each member ofthe board of directors of each school district in such educationalservice district. Such notice shall include instructions and rulesestablished by the superintendent of public instruction for the conductof the election.
